chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja‘far (عليه السلام).
He was asked about the mines of gold, silver, iron, lead, and brass, so he said: “Upon them is khums (the one-fifth tax).”

key_terms.الذَّهَبِ: gold as a mined precious metal
key_terms.الصُّفْرِ: brass or yellow copper mentioned among mined materials
key_terms.الْخُمُسُ: the one-fifth levy due on specified categories of wealth
key_terms.الْفِضَّةِ: silver as a mined precious metal
key_terms.مَعَادِنِ: mines or mineral resources extracted from the earth

ai.seo_question: Is khums obligatory on minerals such as gold, silver, iron, and brass?
ai.summary: This hadith states that khums is due on extracted minerals such as gold, silver, iron, lead, and brass. It is a concise legal ruling transmitted from Abu Ja‘far (عليه السلام) concerning financial obligations related to mineral resources.
